title: CSCI 632 — Mobile Robot Programming
subject: Computer Vision
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core software architecture components required for mobile robot programming, including reactive control loops and modular design patterns.
Explain how reactive motion control algorithms process sensor data to generate real-time navigation commands.
Demonstrate the integration of map building and localization techniques to enable autonomous path planning in dynamic environments.
